title: External anharmonic oscillator dynamics applicability audit for exact Q3
question: Do established infinite-volume anharmonic-oscillator dynamics theorems directly supply the exact Q3LOCK common real-time alpha, or do their hypotheses stop at a reference-only QFT interface?
method: Read the primary arXiv record and theorem summary for arXiv:0909.2249, including its finite-measure perturbation and Lieb--Robinson hypotheses for thermodynamic-limit W-star dynamics.
Read the primary arXiv record for arXiv:1605.05259 and separate its bounded-nearest-neighbor resolvent-algebra theorem from its indications for singular or non-harmonic interactions.
Crosswalk both contracts against the registered Q3LOCK quartic onsite polynomial and unbounded bilinear q_y dot q_z interaction.
Freeze the required regularization, common-core, uniform D/delta-D, and resolvent-to-OS/KMS bridge as the next route contract.
finding: The external literature confirms that thermodynamic-limit W-star dynamics and KMS/ground-state constructions are mathematically available for suitable oscillator interaction classes. The exact Q3LOCK polynomial terms do not satisfy the cited finite-variation Weyl-integral or bounded-nearest-neighbor hypotheses by inspection, and the repository has not supplied the missing uniform regularization-removal estimates. Direct import is therefore rejected as an applicability mismatch, while the resolvent-algebra/exact-polynomial common-alpha route remains viable and is now the precise successor target.
decision_reason: The source audit prevents a known QFT dynamics theorem from being treated as proof of the exact Q3 common alpha without checking the polynomial interaction, domain, representation and uniform-limit hypotheses. It narrows the live proof to a regularized polynomial/resolvent carrier and preserves the existing direct-import negative boundary.

adversarial_review.check: Polynomial multipliers are not silently treated as finite-variation Weyl measures.
The bounded-nearest-neighbor resolvent theorem is not cited as an exact unbounded Q3 theorem.
A resolvent-algebra limit is not identified with the existing configuration OS mixture without a separate map.
Finite-volume or fixed-cutoff estimates are not promoted to all-exhaustion or cutoff-uniform bounds.
No common alpha, KMS/OS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure is inferred.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing source-applicability audit. It supplies no exact Q3 common-core estimate, direct D/delta-D Cauchy theorem, exhaustion independence, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS identification, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

qft_interface.closed: Applicability boundary and a precise regularization/common-core successor contract.
qft_interface.open: Exact polynomial resolvent dynamics, source/volume/beta/orientation-uniform D/delta-D estimates, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS/KMS identification, GNS gap and continuum.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is involved.

next_action: Construct and test the regularized Q3 polynomial interaction on a resolvent or energy-damped common core; require uniform full-versus-regularized D/delta-D bounds before importing any QFT KMS or W-star conclusion.
